question.text: Per the NISM-XXI-B workbook, asset allocation decisions contribute to portfolio returns most significantly via:

answer.text: Strategic asset allocation, which the workbook describes as a major determinant of risk and return

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook identifies strategic asset allocation as a major determinant of risk and return, citing Brinson and Ibbotson evidence. The Trap: The often-quoted "80-90% of returns from SAA" shorthand is not what the workbook says. The workbook reports about 40% of the variation in returns across portfolios on average, and about 90% of the variation in returns over time for a single fund. Note: Per NISM-XXI-B workbook (p.175).
